description: This file defines a React component for generating tickets within an event ticketing web application. It includes UI elements for inputting attendee details, selecting ticket types, generating tickets, downloading PDFs, and sending emails. It leverages external API functions for ticket operations and interacts with various UI components.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates an attendee's row data in the state.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new attendee row to the list.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes an attendee row at a specified index.

methods.name: onGenerate
methods.description: Handles ticket generation form submission, validates input, calls API, and sets preview state.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Downloads the ticket PDF for a given ticket ID.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Sends a ticket via email for a given ticket ID.
